disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder; clinical diagnosis confirmed using gold-standard instruments (ADI-revised and ADOS). IQ ≥ 50 required. Psychiatric comorbidities (except psychosis or bipolar disorder) were allowed.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "All autistic participants had an existing clinical diagnosis of autism that was confirmed using the combined information of gold-standard diagnostic instruments, the ADI revised and the ADOS."

dataset-of-origin.detail: EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP); multisite (six collaborating sites)
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Participants were part of the EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS LEAP cohort. They underwent comprehensive clinical, cognitive and MRI assessment at one of six collaborating sites."
